name: North Gate Outpost
summary: At North Gate Outpost, mountaineers guard the road where Dun Morogh meets Loch Modan. Their patrols shield travelers from beasts in the crags.

sections.title: Guards of the Pass
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers watch North Gate Pass from the outpost. They guard travelers heading through the mountain tunnels into Loch Modan. The pass marks Dun Morogh’s northeastern edge, where harsh weather and steep ravines make patrols perilous. When patrols go missing or predators threaten the road, the garrison calls on travelers to scout the ridges.

faq.q: What is North Gate Outpost used for?
aliases: why is north gate outpost here
faq.answer: North Gate Outpost gives the mountaineers a post from which to guard North Gate Pass, the northern road between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. They drive back wild beasts to keep the route open to trade and travel.

faq.q: Where does the road through the pass lead?
aliases: where does north gate pass go
faq.answer: The road runs east through mountain tunnels into Loch Modan, or west toward Kharanos and Ironforge.

faq.q: Why do the mountaineers need help from travelers?
faq.answer: Territorial beasts prowl the snowy cliffs, and mountaineers have gone missing in the crags while hunting them. The garrison needs scouts to search for the missing mountaineers and learn their fates.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the mountaineers’ duty: keeping the highland passes open through freezing weather and prowling predators.
As a gnome, you can use your wits and marksmanship to help the dwarven garrison track down lost patrols.
